movingelevators.elevator_controller.tool: Place elevator controllers above each other to create floors for an elevator
movingelevators.elevator_display.tooltip: Shows an elevators' floors when placed on top of an elevator controller or remote elevator panel
movingelevators.remote_controller.toolti: Can be bound to an elevator controller by right-clicking on it
Bound to elevator controller at (%1$d, %2$d, %3$d) in %4$s
movingelevators.remote_controller.not_bo: The block must be bound to an Elevator Controller!
movingelevators.remote_controller.wrong_: The block must be in the same dimension as the Elevator Controller!
movingelevators.remote_display.tooltip: Shows the floor an elevator is currently at. Bind it to an elevator controller by right-clicking on it
movingelevators.remote_indicator.tooltip: A slim wall-mounted panel showing the floor an elevator is currently at. Bind it to an elevator controller by right-clicking on it
movingelevators.remote_call_panel.toolti: A wall-mounted landing panel with a floor readout and up/down call buttons. Bind it to an elevator controller by right-clicking on it. Right-click a controller in each of several shafts to have one panel serve them all — a press then sends whichever of them is best placed to answer. Right-click a controller again to unlink it; sneak and right-click the air to empty the item. Sneak-click a placed panel to see what it is linked to
movingelevators.elevator_car_panel.toolt: The panel you ride with: shows the current floor and direction, and opens a floor list when clicked. Bind it to an elevator controller by right-clicking on it
movingelevators.floor_select.title: Select a floor
movingelevators.bank_car_panel.tooltip: The panel you ride with in an elevator bank: shows the current floor and direction, and opens the doors or rings the alarm when clicked. It has no floor buttons, because in a bank you enter your destination at the lobby panel before you board. Bind it to an elevator controller by right-clicking on it
movingelevators.car_controls.title: Elevator
movingelevators.bank_lobby_panel.tooltip: Link it to ONE elevator controller in each shaft it should serve — right-click that controller with it. The panel finds the rest of the shaft's floors, and its own landing, by itself, so there is no need to link every floor. Right-click a controller again to unlink it. The item keeps its links after you place a panel, so one lobby panel per floor takes no extra work; sneak and right-click the air to empty it for a different bank. Sneak-click a placed panel to see what it is linked to
movingelevators.bank_lobby.title: Enter your destination floor
movingelevators.bank_lobby.unbound: This panel isn't linked to any elevators yet
movingelevators.bank_lobby.no_car: No linked elevator can reach that floor
movingelevators.bank_lobby.dispatched: An elevator is on its way — going to %s
movingelevators.bank_lobby.dispatched_na: Elevator %s is on its way — going to %s
movingelevators.bank_lobby.ready: An elevator is ready to board — going to %s
movingelevators.bank_lobby.ready_named: Elevator %s is ready to board — going to %s

movingelevators.bank_lobby_panel.unbound: Elevator unlinked. This panel now serves %s elevator(s)
movingelevators.bank_lobby_panel.copied: Copied. This panel item now serves %s elevator(s)
movingelevators.elevator_door.tooltip: A 2x2 sliding doorway. Place it at an elevator landing and it finds that elevator by itself: it opens when the cabin arrives and closes again on its own. Redstone power forces it open
movingelevators.elevator_single_door.too: A 1x2 sliding doorway. Place it at an elevator landing and it finds that elevator by itself: it opens when the cabin arrives and closes again on its own. Redstone power forces it open
movingelevators.elevator_door.status.sea: No elevator landing found within %s blocks at this height.
movingelevators.elevator_door.status.no_: That controller is gone, or belongs to a different elevator.
movingelevators.elevator_door.status.lan: Door at y=%1$s serves landing y=%2$s
movingelevators.elevator_door.status.cab: Cabin at this landing: %1$s (cabin is on floor index %2$s)
movingelevators.elevator_door.not_bound: These doors are not bound to an elevator controller!

movingelevators.floor_select.independent: Answers its own buttons only, not the floors
movingelevators.alarm_linker.tooltip: SNEAK and right-click a fire alarm panel, then right-click an elevator controller. The elevator returns to that controller's floor whenever that alarm sounds. Sneak and right-click the air to forget the panel
movingelevators.alarm_linker.tooltip.hol: Holding fire alarm panel at %s — now right-click an elevator controller
movingelevators.alarm_linker.selected: Fire alarm panel selected at %s — now right-click an elevator controller
movingelevators.alarm_linker.no_panel: Sneak and right-click a fire alarm panel first
movingelevators.alarm_linker.no_elevator: That controller is not part of an elevator yet
movingelevators.alarm_linker.paired: Elevator paired to the fire alarm panel at %s
